chunk.text: Join kids health family

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Wow, Tia! You were so brave!

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Thanks, Tofu! Will you please take care of the bird while I go and change?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes!

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Did you save this little bird, young man?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes, I did!

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: That's very good of you. You are a brave boy!

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: While we take care of the little bird, can I tell you all a little story?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes! We want a story!

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: One day, her mother, the queen told her that she had fixed her marriage with a prince.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The son of our friend, King of Shazam is a wonderful prince.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You will be very happy with him.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You must leave for Shazam immediately to meet the king and the prince.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Take your maid with you and take this handkerchief.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Anytime you feel confused, keep it close to your heart and you will know what to do.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes, mother!

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The princess set forth for her journey with her maid.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But on the way, the maid changed her behaviour entirely.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I refuse to serve you anymore.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Now onward, you will be my maid and I will be the princess.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: And if you tell anyone about this, you will be cursed.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Give me your clothes and possessions right now.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The princess was gentle-hearted and so she agreed.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: As tears rolled down her cheeks, she wiped them with her mother's handkerchief.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Suddenly, it spoke to her.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: If the queen were to know of the maid's behaviour, she would be heartbroken.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Hence, the princess decided never to tell anyone about her true identity

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and went along as a maid to Shazam.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: When they reached Shazam, the maid decided to get rid of the princess.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I do not need my maid anymore.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You can assign her some other job.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The minister assigned the princess to work on a geese farm

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: with a man named Kurtkan.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: It was her job to take care of the geese.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The princess learned everything about her job and became a very good goose girl.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: One day, Kurtkan and the princess got into a fight

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and Kurtkan went to complain about her to the king.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I do not wish to keep the goose girl.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: She is horrible and strange things happen around her all the time.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Is that so?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Let me investigate this matter myself.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The king started following the princess.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: He noticed that she was a sincere and sweet girl

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and there was nothing wrong with her.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: He also thought there was extreme sadness about her

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: so he decided to talk to her.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Dear girl, is there a secret close to your heart?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes, your majesty. There is.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But alas, I cannot share it with anyone

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: because no one should know about it.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Why don't you tell it to the big boulder over there?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: It can't tell anyone anything.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The girl agreed

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and told the boulder everything.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But she didn't know that the king was hiding behind the boulder

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and heard everything.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The next day, the king went to the court and summoned the maid

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and told her the story of the princess and the maid and asked her

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: what punishment would be fit for such a maid.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The maid did not realize that it was her own story

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and came up with the hardest punishment.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Such a person should be flogged and sent away from the kingdom forever, your majesty.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Correct.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Gods, take this imposter away.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: She has been living amongst us as a princess

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: while the real princess has been toiling as a goose girl.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: She flogged this liar and banished her from the kingdom.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The gods immediately grabbed the maid and took her away.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: That night, the king threw a gala ball

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: and celebrated the real princess as his son's wife to be.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: That is a very good story.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Thank you. What do you think, Tofu?

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You are right, Tia.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: People who take up another person's identity are wrong.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I am sorry, everyone. I lied to you all.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: It was Tia who saved the little bird, not me.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Thank you for telling the truth, Tofu.

chunk.title: The Goose Girl Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes, thank you for telling the truth. It was very brave of you.
